_doc: The optional first-days tutorial (ADR-0062): Remand Program cards on the tether's journal, listed by order. Steps count in any order; the journal's current step is the first not done; once all are done the tether picks up Ezra's distress call (data/config/tutorial.json). event: gather (items picked up or harvested; targets: item ids; count sums them), craft (targets: item ids), build (a blueprint finished; targets: blueprint or structure ids, an assembly blueprint reports its structure: bough_bed builds a bedroll), fell_tree, place_log, sleep, loot, enter_poi, read_note, kill, recruit. body: {key:<input action>} shows the key that action is bound to now (TutorialTracker.render_body). Recipes quoted in a body must match data/recipes and data/blueprints (test_tutorial checks the ones named).

defs.title: Gather sticks, stones and fibre
defs.body: REMAND PROGRAM · FIRST DAYS. You were issued nothing that cuts. Make it. Hold {key:interact} on ferns and huckleberry bushes under the trees for plant fibre (fireweed in the clearings and sedge by the water give more), on deadfall for sticks, on loose stones for stones (thickest by the water). Bring in six. You need at least 3 plant fibre, 1 stick and 1 stone for the next card.

defs.title: Make a stone axe
defs.body: Open the salvage roll ({key:inventory}), flap Make by hand. Twist Cordage from 3 plant fibre. Then the Stone Axe: 1 stick, 1 stone, 1 cordage. It goes on your toolbelt's first free slot (a number key over it in the roll moves it). It chops, and it is a weapon. Not a good one.

defs.title: Fell a tree
defs.body: Axe in hand, {key:attack} at the trunk. It falls away from you: never stand along its line. It breaks into logs, with sticks and boughs at the crown. {key:interact} on a log, Pick up log, shoulders it (two at most); {key:drop} sets it down. Felling is loud. Look around between swings.

defs.title: Build a campfire
defs.body: Field manual ({key:guidebook}), Blueprints, Campfire, Lay it out. Aim, {key:attack} to place. {key:interact} on the ghost hands over 6 stones and 4 sticks. {key:interact} again lights it from the lighter in your pack. Look at it: {key:drop}, add fuel, feeds it. Warmth, cooking, light. Also a beacon.

defs.title: Fill and boil water
defs.body: Drink your issued water when thirsty. Keep the bottle. At the pond or the river, hold {key:interact} with the empty bottle to fill it. Stream water makes you sick: boil it. {key:interact} on your lit campfire, Use Campfire, Boil Water: 1 Bottle of Stream Water makes 1 Bottle of Boiled Water.

defs.title: Make a cloth bandage
defs.body: You were issued 2 cloth. Salvage roll ({key:inventory}), Make by hand, Cloth Bandage: 2 cloth. It stops bleeding. A hare pelt and a knife make two more. Keep one on you: someone out there will need it. Painkillers and first aid kits are found, not made: medicine cabinets and nightstands in the houses.

defs.title: Raise a shelter
defs.body: Field manual ({key:guidebook}), Blueprints. Lean-to Shelter: 10 sticks, 6 bough bundles, 2 cordage. Bough bundles: fir saplings, felled grey firs, or by hand from 1 stick and 1 plant fibre. Short on time: a Bough Bed, 6 bough bundles and 4 sticks. Either one is a bed.

defs.title: Sleep in your bed
defs.body: {key:interact} on your bed, Sleep. After 19:00 you sleep to 06:00; earlier, two hours. Where you sleep is where the Program wakes you if you die, and it logs your progress. Night falls at 21:00. They see further then, and run. Be at your fire.
